name: constellation
description: Make sense of your STARS. Turns a USC STARS report PDF into a clear, readable summary.

scripts.package:extension: npm test && rm -f dist/constellation-extension-*.zip && cd dist/extension && zip -qrX ../constellation-extension-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:privacy && node test/unit.mjs && node test/extension.mjs && node test/run.mjs
